summary: Frontend-only verification of NIVORAM Phase-3 Diwali festive reskin. Validated festive activation via ?festive=1 across 5 routes (home, collection detail, shop, product detail, gift-finder); normal-mode regression without override and with ?festive=0 (standard gradient #EA3A2E→#F98140, animations='none'); animation scope limited to hero (::before=festive-breathe, .text-flame=flame-drift) and collection-banner-frame (flame-drift + background-size 320% 100%) with footer / product cards / marquee all showing animation-name='none'; gold sparks ::after on span.bg-flame and span.bg-royal badges confirmed (linear-gradient with rgb(217,164,65)); warmer festive gradient (#F0341F → #FF8C33 → #E8B34B) correctly applied as --flame-gradient when festive. Layout integrity verified at 1440x900 desktop and 390x844 mobile on home and collection detail — no horizontal overflow, mobile menu opens, no console errors (only benign Lenis positioning warnings).
critical_code_review_comments: festive.js URL override reads window.location.search once at mount via useEffect in App.js — class is only toggled on initial load; SPA navigation does not re-evaluate. Acceptable for current scope but worth noting if override needs to react mid-session.
Benign Lenis warning: 'container has a non-static position' — appears on multiple routes; unrelated to festive feature but could be cleaned up by adding position:relative to Lenis wrapper.

btn-flame gold ring shadow spec (rgba(217,164,65,0.4)) was not observable on /shop page as no .btn-flame button was present there in viewport; verified gold color token (rgb 217,164,65) is correctly used on badge ::after sparks, so css var wiring is good.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Festive reskin fully passes. Override param ?festive=1 / ?festive=0 is applied once at App mount — class toggle happens in App.js useEffect reading document.documentElement. All critical computed-style checks (gradient var, animation-name on hero::before, .text-flame, collection-banner-frame, exclusion from footer/product cards/marquee, badge ::after gold gradient, normal-mode fallbacks) have been verified via page.evaluate(getComputedStyle). Mobile overflow checks clean at 390px. No console errors except Lenis positioning warnings (pre-existing, unrelated).
